name: Kitashiobara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kitashiobara village emblem in green: a disc divided by a vertical stroke, bearing a stylised horizontal device.
history: Municipal flag of Kitashiobara, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in March 1974.

features.role: Kitashiobara village emblem — a disc divided by a vertical stroke, bearing a stylised horizontal device
